claim: Two rooms that share only part of an edge leave coincident walls that are not paired as a portal; every coincident edge must be one declared wall pair, including zero-height pieces to each other and to the street.
evidence: Met repeatedly in Gravesend (2026-08-27 Market Slip, 2026-11-18 second walk); the rule gate catches unpaired walls.
use: Join rooms through a neck whose whole face is the mouth, or cut the longer edge at the shorter one's ends.
